about: Scenes (what people did, then what the original found) for findings that have no reviewed post. Written by an AI model (claude-sonnet-5-5, the posts lane's writer instructions plus two paragraphs) from the original paper's abstract and, where present, the claim the replication record quotes and a source-reviewed account; nothing about any later study is given to the writer. Each passed a mechanical gate and a second model's check against its card; every scene was then read against its card by Claude, whether or not the check flagged it (`read_on` set), and kept, edited or held out. A reviewed post always replaces a scene here. Producer: /root/wiki-scratch/scenes/.

g010a70045.post: People chose between two options and later rated how attractive each one was. After choosing, some people washed their hands and others did not. Those who didn't wash came to like their pick more and the rejected option less, but people who washed their hands no longer justified their choice that way.
